title: FrameCharts
tagline: Trending Tokens Frame: View Trending Tokens and Token Charts/Info inside Farcaster
description: Trending Tokens Frame: this project allows users on Farcaster network to monitor and analyze trending tokens and view up-to-date information in form of candlestick charts of selected tokens directly on Warpcast through Open Frame standard. It explores a new way for people to view/interact with on-chain data: instead of monitoring multiple sources, it is directly in your social media feed.
how_its_made: This project is build on frames.js SDK. For fetching trending token, it uses AirStack API. For getting historical transaction data and Uniswap statistics, it is using GraphQL API. All information is based on Base blockchain. Frontend is done in React/Next.js and charts are made using Tailwind CSS.
